_note: F4 (0.3.93) — post-build field patches for tools/pregens-to-actors.mjs.
Anything you would otherwise hand-edit onto a built src/packs/pregens/*.json belongs here, so
`node tools/pregens-to-actors.mjs` stays safe to re-run. The generator deep-merges `_all` into
every hero and then the per-slug block (per-slug wins); arrays and scalars replace wholesale.
Identity (class, kit, ancestry, abilities, portrait) belongs in the generator's ROSTER instead,
and gear / chrome / rituals / installed mods belong in loadouts.json. Smoke: node tools/pregen-regen-smoke.mjs
